s.note: the Thanksgiving Day parade in New York
s.how: Mix 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 1 egg, 150ml milk and 30g melted butter into a soft dough. Roll into 24 balls and fry at 175C for 3 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through. Drain and toss in 100g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 100ml cream and pour over 100g chopped dark chocolate, stirring until smooth, for dunking.

s.note: the line to see Kriss Kringle at Cole's
s.how: Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar. Mix in 300g self-raising flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 egg. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut out shapes and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix 200g icing sugar with 2 tbsp water, tint a third red, and pipe on outlines and details.

m.how: Push 60g herb butter under the skin of a 1.5kg turkey breast and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Crumble 300g cornbread with 1 fried onion, 2 celery sticks, 2 tbsp sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock and bake 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and milk. Simmer 150g cranberry sauce with orange zest. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.

w.n: New York pumpkin pie with maple cream
w.how: Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and bake blind at 190C for 12 minutes. Steam 600g peeled pumpkin until soft, drain well and mash smooth. Beat with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml cream, 2 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp ginger and a pinch of nutmeg. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until just set. Cool. Whip 200ml cream with 2 tbsp maple syrup and serve with toasted pecans.

d.note: a cold New York night after the parade
d.how: Pour 1.2L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 2 tbsp maple syrup, 4 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 15 minutes without boiling so the spices infuse. Strain into 4 mugs and add a cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each.
